name: ALM support for Org Apps
description: Introduce robust support for Application Lifecycle Management (ALM). The Public Preview of Org Apps will be updated to support change management via Git and can leverage Fabric Deployment Pipelines. This enables scenarios such as source control integration, version management, Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) for repeatable mission-critical deployments.

result.nameEs: Compatibilidad con ALM en Org Apps
